<!--
Documentation is a first-class deliverable in this repository. Corrections,
clarifications, and missing-attribution reports are all welcome here.
-->

## Which document

- Path (e.g. `docs/reproducibility.md`, `labs/foo/README.md`):
- Section / heading:
- Commit hash you observed the issue on:

## What is wrong or missing

A short, specific description. Quote the exact sentence or paragraph if
useful.

## Why it matters

What a reader could reasonably get wrong because of the current text — for
example, an unclear scope statement, a missing responsible-use note, or a
setup step that will not work on the documented OS.

## Suggested change (optional)

A proposed edit, if you have one. A pull request is welcome; see
[`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Attribution note (optional)

If the issue is that a third party's work is used without proper credit,
please include the source URL and the license, so the fix can land the
correct attribution.
